title: Beef Jerky Essentials
description: Cook rotten flesh into delicious jerky, waste not want not!
body:
# Turn Rotten Flesh Into Something Appetising *Now introducing the new food items... wahoo!* 🎉
--- ## How to Get It Slay zombies and cook their flesh, **or** set them ablaze and let the flames do the work for you. Two products await: | Item | Description | |---|---| | 🥩 **Beef Jerky** | Smelted from rotten flesh | | 🍖 **Crispy Jerky** | Cooked a second time for extra crunch |

--- ## Cooking Chain ``` Rotten Flesh ──smelt──▶ Beef Jerky ──smelt──▶ Crispy Jerky ```

🔥 Bonus: zombies killed while on fire have a chance to drop Beef Jerky directly — no furnace required.
